RT-001.rationale: The replay fixture contains a node with Ready=False.

RT-002.rationale: The replayed Deployment has only one available replica while two are desired.

RT-003.rationale: The replayed workload container defines no readiness, liveness or startup probe.

RT-004.rationale: The replayed workload container has requests but no resource limits.

RT-005.rationale: The replicated Deployment has no matching PodDisruptionBudget.

RT-006.rationale: The replayed workload has no matching NetworkPolicy.
